links.comparator_used: Same LLM (ChatGPT-o3-mini) without context retrieval (baseline, training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Answer quality (relevance, factual accuracy, safety, completeness, conciseness) and preference between RAG and baseline responses
links.effect: LLM-as-a-judge: RAG significantly outperformed baseline across all criteria (P < .001); RAG preferred in 92.8% of comparisons by the LLM judge and 71.2% to 74.8% by human evaluators (P < .001); manual evaluation confirmed significance for accuracy, safety, and completeness (P < .001)
links.quote: The LLM-as-a-judge evaluation showed the RAG system significantly outperformed the baseline across all criteria (P < .001).
